title: Introduce intake categorizer service and autofill condensed release brief
author: Maya Chen
description: Add a lightweight intake categorizer and an automated condensed release-brief autofill used during model onboarding. Motivation: reduce manual tag curation and accelerate release note drafts by surfacing telemetry-driven quality signals (latency drift, top failing prompts, sample perplexity deltas) and provenance links to sample traces. This PR provides a small rule-engine that weights telemetry signals, returns optional coarse-grained category tags in the intake API, injects provenance URIs for flagged samples, and generates a concise release brief template consumed by the onboarding UI and release-assembler. Includes a DB migration for category enums, unit and integration tests, doc samples, and CI adjustments. Checklist: - implement categorizer API and rule engine; - integrate telemetry signals and provenance linker; - add condensed release-brief generator and template; - add docs and examples; - wire auto-brief into the release pipeline as an optional stage; - add tests; - link Linear ENG-3672/ENG-3699. Backwards compatibility: categorizer returns optional metadata only; existing flows fall back to manual tags. No user-facing breaking changes expected. Request reviewers to validate telemetry weights and UX copy for the brief template. Related: onboarding-ui PR to consume /intake/brief endpoint and release-assembler hook (separate).
